say: In this town, nobody whistles after dark.
Because if you whistle, the Tall Man whistles back.
Every night at nine, everyone goes inside, and the streetlights turn off.
Twelve year old Milo had just moved here.
He thought the whole thing was a dumb rule.
So one night, walking home from the store...
Then, from the end of the street... something whistled back.
Something tall and gray was standing under the last streetlight.
Milo ran. The whistling got closer and closer.
He tripped, and fell face first on the sidewalk.
A long gray hand reached down for him...
and handed him the bag he dropped.
Then it slowly pointed at his house.
Milo never whistled after dark again.
Until the next night... when a hundred whistles answered from outside his window.
